Find each ion's 4f configuration and count unpaired electrons using Hund's rule (7 f orbitals).
- Nd3+ (Z=60) is [Xe]4f3, so 3 unpaired.
- Ce3+ (Z=58) is [Xe]4f1, so 1 unpaired.
- Tb3+ (Z=65) is [Xe]4f8, so 8 - 2 = 6 unpaired.
- Ho3+ (Z=67) is [Xe]4f10, so 14 - 10 = 4 unpaired.
Ho3+ is the only ion with four unpaired electrons.
